title: Pełna macierz testów walk, itemów, merge i replayu Set 2

expected_final_snapshot.acceptance: Default targeting selects the live frontline and reaches the backline only after frontline death.
A dead-only opposing team produces no attack event and clears stale focus.
At the same simulation tick, Team A attack events are emitted before Team B attack events.
Full mana creates one bonus basic attack and does not emit a skill cast.
An enemy death emits the authored attack and defense reward events once per configured recipient.
trigger_once limits the reward to one event for the same ally death.
The low-HP trigger is evaluated against the authoritative HP threshold and marks the effect as triggered.
Trait threshold activation is deterministic and distinguishes below-threshold, exact-threshold, and next-tier states.
The same golden event stream reconstructs the authoritative snapshot in core, backend, and frontend without desync.
Every loaded canonical passive definition runs through a seeded shared-core smoke scenario twice with the same event signature; an unknown passive ID has no fallback definition.
Every loaded canonical trait tier distinguishes below-threshold, exact-threshold and next-tier activation deterministically.
Every canonical passive trigger family has an executable positive scenario and a boundary or negative scenario, including start-passive idempotence and trigger isolation.

workstreams.setup: Authenticated production Game View at 1280x720 and 1920x1080.
steps: Run one live combat with items and Set 2 traits.
Run one replay after reconnect and inspect event order, item effects, and final snapshot.
Repeat at both resolutions and capture browser console plus server request/log evidence.
workstreams.expected: Readable board, no desync or item loss, terminal end event, stable final snapshot.
